description: This file contains Perl code implementing ARM assembly routines for cryptographic operations, specifically ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption and decryption, including functions for processing data blocks, hashing, and finalizing authentication tags.

methods.name: chacha_qr
methods.description: Performs quarter-round operations for ChaCha20 cipher, updating state variables based on direction.

methods.name: poly_add
methods.description: Adds 16-byte vectors to the polynomial accumulator for Poly1305.

methods.name: poly_add_vec
methods.description: Adds a vector to the polynomial accumulator for Poly1305.

methods.name: poly_stage1
methods.description: Performs the first stage of polynomial multiplication for Poly1305.

methods.name: poly_stage2
methods.description: Performs the second stage of polynomial multiplication for Poly1305.

methods.name: poly_reduce_stage
methods.description: Reduces the polynomial product modulo the prime for Poly1305.

methods.name: poly_mul
methods.description: Performs full polynomial multiplication and reduction for Poly1305.

methods.name: chacha_qr_x3
methods.description: Performs three rounds of ChaCha20 quarter-round transformations in a specific direction.

methods.name: chacha_qr_x5
methods.description: Performs five rounds of ChaCha20 quarter-round transformations in a specific direction, processing multiple blocks in parallel.
